findings.summary: build_features standardizes using mean/std of the whole DataFrame, and train.py calls it before train_test_split, leaking test statistics into training and making test AUC optimistic.

judge.reason: Describes whole-dataset scaling before split leaking test stats, exactly b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Mean and std are recomputed from whatever DataFrame is passed at inference, so a single row gives NaN std (all features NaN) and small batches are standardized against themselves, making predictions batch-dependent; fitted statistics are not persisted.

judge.reason: Describes train/serve skew and single-row NaN std, both known other problems, not the leakage bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Constant (zero-variance) columns give std 0, so the division yields NaN/inf, which will make LogisticRegression raise.

judge.reason: Zero-variance column producing NaN/inf is a known other problem.

findings.label: valid_other
